The design brief / Self-initiated study

The brief.

A long-form annual-report study organising strategy, operations, governance and financial information within a readable narrative.

The challenge

A long annual report must keep strategic narrative, operational updates, governance and financial detail navigable.

Design direction.

Build the document around clear section transitions, repeatable typographic hierarchy and distinct treatment for financial information.
